description: Public Transport Services is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by South Australian Governments. Contains the number of boardings that have occurred at each stop, for each trip of each route over a given week. Please note this is a trial data set and accuracy is not guaranteed. Update Frequency TBA. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher South Australian Governments. Its tags are bus, passenger boarding summary, public transport, routes, stops. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
